scope: Supervised local operator workflow; not a hands-free or whole-ecosystem benchmark.
operator: Joshua’s recovered LocalNova lineage, distinct from active Nova World.

hardware.source: Read-only Windows CIM query; no serial numbers collected.

workflow: Recall a real retained owner instruction with the local conversation model.
Ask the installed local coding model to create release_manifest.
Reject invalid metadata; supply specific feedback to the same task.
Load the generated capability and run it against three actual company-review files.
Independently compare file counts, UTF-8 bytes and hashes.
Detect an empty-input defect; apply one supervised guard correction.
Verify negative cases, Unicode inputs and fresh-process context/tool reload.

supervision.requests: Codex submitted owner-authorized requests through the actual interface.
supervision.file_binding: Reviewed adapter supplied only the three registered company-review text files.
supervision.generated_tool: Local model wrote the plugin. Codex changed one conditional from falsey-files to files-is-None after the empty-input test. Original outputs and failure evidence are retained privately.
supervision.dispatch: Explicit owner commands, not automatic natural-language planning/dispatch.
supervision.capture: Actual browser screenshots sampled during live interaction, edited with labelled wait cuts; not uninterrupted real-time footage. Editorial narration is separately synthesized using Windows desktop speech.
supervision.model_scope: Operator model requests go to local Ollama. Codex supervision is separate; the whole supervised demonstration is not represented as offline.

verified_checks: Unicode byte count and hash independently match
Missing, wrong-container and non-string inputs rejected
Fresh process reloads saved context and generated capability
source_disclosure: Private original source, memory, prompts, job logs, runtime paths and infrastructure configuration are excluded. Public evidence contains selected results only.
not_claimed: No fresh benchmark on the historical 4 GB Acer.
No fully offline physical-microphone or hands-free acceptance.
No automatic bridge between Nova World and Homestead.
No unattended perfect code generation, worldwide novelty, registered trademark or patent.

recording.narration: Editorial Windows voice; not represented as a live operator reply.
recording.capture: Actual sampled browser capture during live requests. Waits shortened, supervision labelled; no fabricated application results.

chapters.title: Meet the builder. Explore the operation.

input_snapshot: The three registered project-review files as they existed at execution time. Later presentation edits mean these are not the final website release checksums. The publication patch has a separate exact-file manifest.
